19:2: This is a mention of your Rabb's mercy to His servant Zechariah.
19:3: When he had called upon his Rabb secretly.
19:4: He said: 'My Rabb, surely from me the bones have weakened and my head has flared up white. My Rabb, I have not been unblessed in praying to You.'
19:5: Surely I have feared the relatives after me, and my wife was barren; grant me from Your presence a protector.
19:6: Let him be an heir to me and an heir to the family of Jacob, and make him well-pleasing, my Rabb.
19:7: O Zechariah, surely We give you good tidings of a boy whose name is Yahya; We have not made for him any namesake before.
19:8: He said: 'My Rabb, how can I have a boy when my wife is barren and I have grown completely aged from old age?'
19:9: He said: 'Thus it is. Your Rabb said: It is easy for Me. I had created you before, and you were nothing.'
19:10: He said: 'My Rabb, make for me a sign.' He said: 'Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, although being sound.'
19:11: Thereupon he came out to his people from the sanctuary and signaled to them to glorify (Allah) morning and evening.
19:12: O Yahya, hold the Book with strength; and We gave him judgment while he was a child.
19:13: And compassion from Our presence and purity; and he was a possessor of taqwa.
19:14: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a tyrant, disobedient.
19:15: Peace be upon him the day he was born, the day he will die, and the day he will be raised alive.
19:16: Mention Mary in the Book, when she had withdrawn from her family to a place toward the east.
19:17: Then she had taken a veil from them, so We sent to her Our Spirit, and he appeared to her as a well-formed human being.
19:18: She says: 'Surely I seek refuge in ar-Rahman from you, if you are one who fears (Him).'
19:19: He says: "Surely I am the messenger of your Rabb, to grant you a pure son."
19:20: She says: "How can I have a son when no human has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
19:21: He said, 'Thus it is; your Rabb said: It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign for the people and a mercy from Us, and it was a matter decreed.'
19:22: Thereupon she carried him, and she withdrew with him to a distant place.
19:23: The pain of childbirth brings her to the trunk of the date-palm. She says: "Would that I had died before this and become a forgotten thing."
19:24: From below her, he calls to her: "Do not grieve, your Rabb has made a stream beneath you."
19:25: Shake toward yourself the trunk of the date-palm so that fresh dates fall upon you.
19:26: So eat, drink, and let your eyes be delighted. If you see any one of the humans, say: "Surely I have vowed a fast to ar-Rahman, today I will not speak to any human."
19:27: Thus she came to her people carrying him; they said: 'O Mary, you have indeed done a very dreadful thing.'
19:28: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not a bad man, and your mother was not unchaste.
19:29: She pointed to him. They said: "How shall we speak with someone who was a child in the cradle?"
19:30: He said: 'Surely I am the servant of Allah; He gave me the Book and made me a prophet.'
19:31: And He made me blessed wherever I may be, and enjoined upon me the salah and the zakat as long as I live.
19:32: And dutiful to my mother, and He did not make me a tyrant, unblessed.
19:33: And peace is upon me the day I was born, the day I will die, and the day I will be raised alive.
19:34: This is Jesus, son of Mary; the word of truth about which they doubt.
19:35: It is not for Allah to take a child. He is exalted above that. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it "Be", and it immediately is.
19:36: And surely Allah is my Rabb and your Rabb, so worship Him; this is a straight path.
19:37: But the sects differed among themselves; woe to those who disbelieve from the witnessing of a great day.
19:38: Hear them and see, the day they come to Us! But the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
19:39: Warn them of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be decreed; they are in heedlessness and they do not believe.
19:40: Surely We will inherit the earth and whoever is upon it, and to Us they will be returned.
19:41: Mention Abraham in the Book. Surely he was a very truthful prophet.
19:42: At that time he said to his father: 'O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear, does not see, and does not benefit you anything?'
19:43: O my father, surely there has come to me of knowledge that which did not come to you. Follow me so that I may guide you to an even path.
19:44: O my father, do not worship Satan; surely Satan has been rebellious to ar-Rahman.
19:45: O my father, I fear that a punishment from ar-Rahman may touch you so that you become a friend to Satan.
19:46: He said: 'O Abraham, are you turning away from my gods? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you. Leave me for a long time.'
19:47: He said: "Peace be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you from my Rabb. Surely He has been gracious to me."
19:48: And I withdraw from you and what you worship besides Allah, and I pray to my Rabb. It may be that I will not be unblessed in praying to my Rabb.
19:49: When he withdrew from them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and each one We made a prophet.
19:50: And We bestowed upon them of Our mercy, and We made for them a lofty tongue of truthfulness.
19:51: Mention Moses in the Book; surely he was chosen, and he was a messenger, a prophet.
19:52: We called to him from the right side of the Mount (Tur) and brought him near in secret conversation.
19:53: And We granted him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
19:54: Mention Ishmael in the Book, because he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger, a prophet.
19:55: He used to enjoin upon his family the salah and the zakat, and was well-pleasing in the sight of his Rabb.
19:56: Mention Idris in the Book as well; surely he was a very truthful prophet.
19:57: And We raised him to a lofty place.
19:58: Those are the prophets whom Allah has blessed; from the offspring of Adam, from those We carried with Noah, from the offspring of Abraham and Israel, and from those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of ar-Rahman are recited to them, they fall down prostrating and weeping.
19:59: Then after them came a generation who wasted the salah and followed lusts. They will meet with deviation.
19:60: Except those who repent, believe, and do righteous deeds; those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged in anything.
19:61: Gardens of Eden which ar-Rahman promised to His servants in the unseen; surely His promise is to come.
19:62: There they do not hear any vain talk, but only peace. And there their provision is theirs morning and evening.
19:63: That is the Paradise which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who possess taqwa.
19:64: We descend only by the command of your Rabb; to Him belongs whatever is before us, whatever is behind us, and whatever is between them, and your Rabb is not forgetful.
19:65: He is the Rabb of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between the two, so be patient in His worship; do you know of any namesake for Him?
19:66: Man says: 'Is it when I die that I will truly be brought forth alive?'
19:67: Does man not remember that We created him before, when he was nothing?
19:68: By your Rabb, We will surely gather them and the devils, then We will surely bring them present around Hell, kneeling.
19:69: Then We will surely pull out from every group whichever of them was most severe in rebellion against al-Rahman.
19:70: Then We surely know best those who are more worthy of burning in it in Hell.
19:71: And there is none of you who will not pass through it; this is a finalized decree upon your Rabb.
19:72: Then We deliver those who guard against evil and leave the wrongdoers in it, kneeling.
19:73: When Our verses are recited to them clearly, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: 'Which of the two groups is better in position and finer in assembly?'
19:74: How many a generation We destroyed before them who were better in goods and appearance.
19:75: Say: 'Whoever is in error, let al-Rahman grant him respite, until when they see what they were promised, either the punishment or the Hour, they will know who is worse in place and weaker in forces.'
19:76: And Allah increases guidance for those who are guided, and the enduring righteous deeds are better with your Rabb in reward and better in return.
19:77: Have you seen the person who disbelieved in Our verses and said: 'I will surely be given wealth and children'?
19:78: Has he known the unseen, or has he taken a covenant from the presence of al-Rahman?
19:79: Never! We will write what he says and We will extend the punishment for him extensively.
19:80: And We will inherit what he says, and he will come to Us alone.
19:81: They took deities other than Allah so that they might be an honor for them.
19:82: No, they will deny their worship and become adversaries against them.
19:83: Did you not see that We sent the devils upon the disbelievers, constantly inciting them?
19:84: So do not hasten against them; We are only counting a count for them.
19:85: On that Day We will gather the people of taqwa to al-Rahman as a delegation.
19:86: And We will drive the criminals into Hell, thirsty.
19:87: None will possess intercession except the one who has taken a covenant from the presence of al-Rahman.
19:88: And they said: 'al-Rahman has taken a child.'
19:89: By oath, you have brought a very monstrous thing.
19:90: Almost the heavens split from it, and the earth splits, and the mountains fall down.
19:91: Because they attribute a child to al-Rahman, almost the heavens tear apart, the earth splits, and the mountains collapse.
19:92: It is not befitting for al-Rahman to take a child.
19:93: Everyone who is in the heavens and the earth will come to al-Rahman as a servant.
19:94: By oath, He has counted them and numbered them one by one.
19:95: And all of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.
19:96: Undoubtedly, for those who believe and do righteous deeds, al-Rahman will establish a love.
19:97: We have made it easy with your tongue so that with it you may give glad tidings to the people of taqwa and warn an obstinate people.
19:98: How many a generation We destroyed before them; do you sense any one of them or hear a whisper belonging to them?
